VAULT.Title: TTRPG Vault: Compendium & Automation Bridge
VAULT.Description: Bridge and compendium manager connecting TTRPG Vault desktop with Foundry VTT worlds.

BridgePort.Name: Bridge Loopback Port
BridgePort.Hint: Local loopback WebSocket port used by TTRPG Vault desktop application (default: 41782).

AuthToken.Name: Pairing Authentication Token
AuthToken.Hint: Shared secret token matching the pairing token configured in TTRPG Vault desktop settings.

AutoOpen.Name: Auto-Open Imported Sheets
AutoOpen.Hint: Automatically open document sheets when single entities are pushed from TTRPG Vault.

Deduplication.Name: Default Deduplication Mode
Deduplication.Hint: Strategy for importing documents when an entry with matching sourceId already exists in compendium.

MidiAutomation.Name: Enable Midi-QOL Automation
MidiAutomation.Hint: Automatically configure Midi-QOL workflow flags and action triggers when Midi-QOL is active.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Logging
DebugMode.Hint: Enable verbose console logging for troubleshooting bridge events and imports.
